import sys

MOD = 998244353

def power(x: int, y: int, p: int) -> int:
    res = 1
    x %= p
    while y > 0:
        if y & 1:
            res = (res * x) % p
        y >>= 1
        x = (x * x) % p
    return res

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    l = int(data[2])
    r = int(data[3])
    k = n * m
    length = r - l + 1
    mod = MOD

    if k % 2 == 1:
        print(power(length, k, mod))
        return

    ans = (power(length, k, mod) + power(length % 2, k, mod)) * power(2, mod - 2, mod) % mod
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
